text: Our standard annual leave policy grants full-time employees 24 paid leave days per calendar year, accrued monthly at 2 days per month.
Employees can carry forward a maximum of 5 unused leave days into the next calendar year; any excess is forfeited on December 31st.
The reimbursement process for travel expenses requires submitting receipts within 15 days of the trip via the internal Expenses portal.
All reimbursements above INR 10,000 require manager approval before finance processes the payment, typically within 7 business days.
Our flagship product, the Aster Cloud Suite, is priced at INR 4,999 per user per month for the Standard tier and INR 8,999 for the Enterprise tier.
The Enterprise tier of Aster Cloud Suite includes single sign-on, priority support with a 4-hour SLA, and dedicated onboarding.
New employees complete a mandatory 3-day onboarding program covering company policies, security training, and tool setup.
Security training must be renewed annually and includes modules on phishing awareness, data handling, and password hygiene.
Client support tickets are triaged into P1 (critical, 1-hour response), P2 (high, 4-hour response), and P3 (normal, 1-business-day response).
P1 tickets automatically page the on-call engineer via the incident management system regardless of time of day.
Our data retention policy stores customer support conversation logs for 24 months before automatic deletion, unless legally required to retain longer.
Employees working remotely are eligible for a one-time home office stipend of INR 15,000, reimbursed through the standard expense process.
The company's core working hours are 10 AM to 4 PM IST, with flexible start and end times outside that window.
Performance reviews are conducted twice a year, in April and October, and are tied to the annual compensation review cycle.
The referral bonus program pays INR 25,000 to the referring employee after the new hire completes 3 months of employment.
Our parental leave policy provides 26 weeks of paid leave for the primary caregiver and 2 weeks for the secondary caregiver.
All company laptops are enrolled in mobile device management (MDM) and must have disk encryption enabled before first use.
The procurement policy requires three vendor quotes for any purchase above INR 1,00,000 before approval by the finance head.
Customer data is hosted in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai) region exclusively, in line with our data residency commitments to clients.
The company observes 12 public holidays per year, published annually on the internal HR portal by January 1st.
